bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db"
query="SELECT 'PROFILE_TOPIC_TOTAL='||COUNT(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL; SELECT 'PROFILE_TOPIC_BOARDS='||COALESCE(string_agg(board_key||':'||n,',' ORDER BY board_key),'none') FROM (SELECT board_key,COUNT(*) AS n FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND title LIKE '%みんなのプロフ%' GROUP BY board_key) s; SELECT 'PROFILE_GATE_READY='||COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile' AND enabled=TRUE AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AND approved_by IS NOT NULL; SELECT 'PROFILE_GATE_ROW_COUNT='||COUNT(*) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile';"
out="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$query")"
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
{ printf 'PR47_LIVE_PROFILE_GATE_READBACK\n%s\nIMAGE=%s\nBOT_RUNNING=%s\n' "$out" "$image" "$running"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
